Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the earlier help during our POC. I discovered this morning that our sandbox trial expired on Aug 15 and we were cut off right before an internal demo next week (execs want to see a live run-through on Aug 25). We have some remaining tests that would prove integration and performance, but we need additional credits to finish them.

Can Redwood temporarily reactivate our trial and add $250 in sandbox credits? Short timeline — if we can get access by Monday Aug 23 it should be enough for the demo. I attached a usage screenshot showing the abrupt cutoff.

Attachment: usage-report-aurora-aug15.png (image/png)

Also: our procurement team (procurement@auroraanalytics.com) will need a short statement of terms so they can approve the temporary spend. Happy to jump on a quick call if that helps.

Appreciate any expedited assistance — this demo is high-visibility for us.

Best,

Aurora Analytics

We can offer a one-time emergency reactivation: 30-day sandbox access + $300 in promo credits to cover the remaining tests. I need internal sign-off for the promo credit but want to reserve the offer for you.

Quick asks from our side:
- Can your procurement contact confirm the email address we should send invoice/terms to?
- Do you require an updated SOW or is a short "one-time credit" confirmation sufficient for approval?

I'll loop in our sales ops to authorize the credit — pinging Monica and Marissa on this thread. If approved, the credits will be applied and I'll include step-by-step access for the sandbox and an ephemeral API key for the demo.

If you want to accept now, reply with "Accept" and the procurement email so we can expedite.

Best,

Head of Sales Engineering
